statements.status_notes: plexus-utils is bundled inside the ruby-maven-libs gem, which logstash uses solely for Maven dependency resolution via jar-dependencies. The vulnerable org.codehaus.plexus.util.Expand.extractFile code path is never invoked: logstash performs all archive extraction using Ruby-native libraries (rubyzip, Gem::Package::TarReader), not Maven/plexus tooling.
